$comment: Draft JSON Schema for the face: section of products/<x>/manifest.json (ADR-1306). Frozen at Phase 00; product-lint KNOWN_FIELDS gains 'face' in the same change that first uses it (Phase 05, the evolve: precedent). Fields exactly: room, ring, kinds, actors, sanctioned, stations, decisions, numbers, concepts.

room.description: room id, unique across manifests; must appear in the expected set

kinds.description: spine kinds this room renders typed; anything else renders generically

actors.description: spine actor prefixes whose receipts belong to this room's feed

sanctioned.description: sanctioned file ids (the L2 /api/file/:id allow-list entries) this room reads — file-borne panels get the file-not-log badge

stations.description: this room's line on the Map, in pipeline order (ADR-1304)

label.description: verbatim — the command/script that performs the step

type.description: circle = machine step, square = stamp (human decides), lock = seal (forever-human)

kind.description: the spine kind whose receipt lights this station, if any

chip.description: the exact CLI the human runs himself — copy, never execute

shared.description: true = joined by several lines (drawn once, by kind)

decisions.description: approval.requested profiles (gate/subject values) whose stamp cards surface in this room's Decide zone

numbers.description: the room's Numbers-zone tiles; every tile renders with Why? precedents and honest states

source.description: the derivation: kind filter, file id, or reader function — never a stored value

concepts.description: verbatim vocabulary chips; each must resolve to a station in this room (⌘K backing store)
